meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在完成或修改界面后会自动做视觉验收：截取网页或终端界面的证据，运行像素对比与两轮只读审查（设计系统/功能性、视觉保真度/中日韩文字），最后给出整体“好/坏”判定。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何 UI（网页或终端界面）之后，或当被问页面/组件/TUI 看起来是否正常时触发；也可通过“视觉 QA”“UI 看起来不对”等关键词唤起。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页，帮我做一轮视觉 QA。
say.note: 会截屏对比设计意图并给出好/坏判定。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面的边框和文字对齐。
say.note: 会抓取终端输出并检查溢出与错位。

say.text: 这个页面和设计稿差多少？
say.note: 会运行像素 diff 输出相似度分数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs visual QA on UIs: captures browser or terminal evidence, runs pixel diff and two read-only review passes (design/functional, visual/CJK fidelity), then gives an overall good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI (web or TUI), or when asked whether a page/component/TUI looks right; also via keywords like 'visual QA' or 'UI looks wrong'.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page, run visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Captures screenshots and yields a good/bad verdict.

say_en.text: Check the alignment of this terminal UI.
say_en.note: Captures terminal output and checks overflow/misalignment.

say_en.text: How far is this page from the design mock?
say_en.note: Runs pixel diff and reports similarity.
